sorted.data

tenth.percentile

  index <- ceiling(length(sorted.data) * i)

}

}

}

# Task 8 - Calculate the trimmed mean

```{r}
raw.mean < - mean(bankData$balance)
raw.median < - median(bankData$balance)

# for T= 0.1 we want to remove the top and bottom 10% of the values ( in terms of size)
# first calculate the tenth and nonetieth percentile


tenth.percentile <- quantile(bankData$balance, 0.1)
ninetieth.percentile <-(bankData$balance,0.9)

# then select the only rows where balance is between these two values
trimmed <- bankData[bankData$balance > tenth.percentile & bankData$balance < nintieth.percentile, ]
trimmed.mean <- mean(trimmed$balance)
trimmed.mean

# the median value is exactly in the centre of the dataset. The smaller the difference between the mean and the
# median the more representative that mean is

raw.difference <- abs(raw.median - raw.mean)
trimmed.difference <- abs(raw.median - trimmed.mean)

print(paste("Raw difference is " , raw.difference))
print(paste(" Trimmed difference is " trimmed.difference))




```
